summary: Frontend-only verification of two Linesheet visual bug fixes at 1920x800. Login (empty fields) → Linesheet via sidebar nav. Both bugs verified fixed; regressions clean; no console errors.

regressions.console_errors: none (only unrelated Recharts warnings on Dashboard)

test_credentials: Login with empty email/password (demo one-click) as per /app/memory/test_credentials.md
context_for_next_testing_agent: Linesheet BUG 1 (MultiSelect clipped by .ls-catalog overflow:hidden) and BUG 2 (nested input border in customer search) are fixed. .ls-catalog now overflow:visible; .ls-search input and .ls-ms-search input have border/outline/box-shadow reset via linesheet.css tail rules. Catalog rounded bottom-corner preserved on .ls-grid/.ls-pager (22px). Route to Linesheet: click sidebar nav-item 'Linesheet' (hash-based #linesheet requires history state).
rca of the issue: BUG1 RCA: .ls-catalog had overflow:hidden to clip the grid into its rounded card, but this also clipped absolute-positioned MultiSelect popovers inside the toolbar. Fix moved overflow to descendants (grid/pager get rounded bottom corners; .ls-catalog is overflow:visible). BUG2 RCA: input inherited default browser border/box-shadow and .ls-search wrapper also had border, causing double outline; tail CSS resets input styles to none and lets container render the single rounded border with focus-within state.
